record.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 This survey covers environmental/economic sustainability of LLMs, energy consumption, deployment and lifecycle practices. It is useful background but synthesizes existing pruning, quantization and deployment strategies rather than adding an evaluated serving optimization.
record.title: A Survey of Sustainability in Large Language Models: Applications, Economics, and Challenges
